description: List the links of a Jira issue: for each, its ID, type, the phrase that reads from this issue to the other one ("blocks", "is blocked by"), and the other issue's key, summary and status. Also returns the link types the site has, each with its name and its two phrases, which are what jira_link_issues takes.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

name: atlassian-mcp__jira_list_issue_links
